A page with no render problems

This page reflows at any width, keeps its text readable with extra spacing and larger text, works in both orientations, and its tooltip can be dismissed, hovered and stays put. (screen reader note)

The card grows with its text. This excerpt is clamped to two lines with an ellipsis on purpose, and the full story is one link away, so the clamp is not counted as text being cut off by the tests that change the spacing or the size of the text.
